mwp_priority_refresh_next_effect = {
    remove_variable = mwp_next_catalog_id
    remove_variable = mwp_next_price
    remove_variable = mwp_next_action
    if = {
        limit = {
            mwp_auto_fresh_trigger = yes
            mwp_auto_supported_trigger = yes
        }
        mwp_collect_script_price_factors_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                mwp_script_price_supported_trigger = yes
            }
            mwp_script_budget_refresh_effect = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        mwp_auto_budget_mode_value = 3
                        has_variable = mwp_script_budget_ready
                    }
                }
                mwp_compute_headroom_effect = yes
                mwp_priority_select_effect = yes
                mwp_reorganization_plan_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_preview_generation
        value = var:mwp_generation
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_preview_gold
        value = gold
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_preview_income
        value = 0
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_script_budget_income
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_preview_income
            value = var:mwp_script_budget_income
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_preview_expenses
        value = monthly_character_expenses
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_preview_budget_mode
        value = mwp_auto_budget_mode_value
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_preview_day
        value = days_since_birth
    }
    remove_variable = mwp_preview_native_balance
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:mwp_input_current_balance
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_preview_native_balance
            value = scope:mwp_input_current_balance
        }
    }
    remove_variable = mwp_preview_cost_sequence
    remove_variable = mwp_preview_fallback_sequence
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:mwp_input_native_cost_sequence
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_preview_cost_sequence
            value = scope:mwp_input_native_cost_sequence
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:mwp_input_fallback_cost_sequence
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_preview_fallback_sequence
            value = scope:mwp_input_fallback_cost_sequence
        }
    }
}
